name: samdesk-support
description: Read selected SamDesk support conversations, find customer agreements and draft a reply in your AI assistant. Uses your existing SamDesk account and current inbox permissions. Private notes, attachments and channel configuration are excluded. This plugin never sends messages or changes conversations.
